curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As vicious murders strike those orbiting the American author, the deadly attacks draw ever closer to Neal himself.
curatedMovie.description: In Italy to promote his latest mystery novel, American author Peter Neal suddenly finds his real-world publicity tour shadowed by a razor-wielding serial killer who targets those close to him.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, heavy, and steady-paced; an engaged, bloody Italian horror-mystery best suited for focused late-night viewing alone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Dario Argento, this 1982 Italian thriller combines meticulous mystery plotting with razor-sharp horror suspense, delivering an intense, heavy-hitting whodunit.
